summary.text: Jonathan Rivera is a Democratic member of the New York State Assembly, representing District 149 since January 2021, and the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for New York State Senate District 61 in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Jonathan Rivera graduated from Hutchinson Central Technical High School and earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from SUNY at Buffalo State College.

According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes working as a branch manager with HSBC Bank, as a legislative liaison, and as a special assistant to the Commissioner of Public Works in Erie County.
Rivera assumed office in the Assembly on January 1, 2021, and is not running for re-election to that seat in 2026.
He won the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary for State Senate District 61, defeating incumbent Jeremy Zellner, 56.0 percent to 43.8 percent.
Ballotpedia lists his Assembly committee assignments as Local Governments and Tourism, Parks, Arts and Sports Development.
